title: Central Government must make provisions to remove difficulties
description: making provisions to remove difficulties in giving effect to the Act

content.what: may make provisions to remove difficulties
conditions: by order in the Official Gazette
not inconsistent with the provisions of this Act
appear to it to be necessary or expedient for removing the difficulty
limitations: no such order shall be made after the expiry of a period of two years from the commencement of this Act
